messages:
Sam (Recruiter): Heads up team — Marco accepted L4 offer earlier today. He just got an external counteroffer and asks if we can bump base by $5k instead of sign-on. Hiring manager prefers sign-on, candidate prefers base.
Elena (Hiring Manager): I want to avoid changing base band if possible. We can increase the sign-on to match retention risk. Any comp policy issues with switching to base after offer accepted?
Rory (People Ops): Changing base after offer acceptance requires comp committee + updated offer amendment + payroll + updated manager justification. Comp typically resists post-offer base changes unless documented market evidence.
Anita (Comp): We need market data and note on internal equity. If switching to base, must show comparator matches and update band rationale. Chair can fast-track if evidence shows counteroffer is permanent.
Sam (Recruiter): Candidate says external offer would be permanent base increase. He prefers base since sign-on would feel temporary. He provided the competitor offer email screenshot (attached).
Anita (Comp): Upload the market comp doc and manager note. If approved, comp will recommend a one-grade adjustment or a base uplift within band midpoint guardrails. This is not a routine sign-on exception.
PeopleOps-Bot: New approval REQ-2026-7760 created: "Post-offer base uplift vs increased sign-on." Routing: Comp -> Legal -> Payroll. Standard SLA 5bd for base changes; expedited possible.
Elena (Hiring Manager): Manager justification: "Key IC with unique infra experience; risk of losing to competitor; role critical to launch Q3." Attached.
Sanjay (Legal): Legal note: if base changes, need an amendment and updated offer letter. Also check equity grant docs for refresh if comp changes materially. I can draft once comp approves.
Payroll Bot: Payroll timing note: base changes effective on hire date need HRIS update before payroll run; if effective retroactively, PR required.
Anita (Comp): After reviewing evidence, comp chair provisionally approves a $3k base uplift (within band) + $2k sign-on to bridge the gap. Rationale: preserve band integrity while addressing retention risk. Requires candidate acceptance of amended offer.
Sam (Recruiter): I spoke with Marco — he'll accept the mixed approach if we confirm it in writing. He asked if benefits start will still be aligned with early hire date (2026-04-20).
Benefits-Bot: Benefits eligibility: can align with hire date if enrollment forms submitted before payroll cutoff. No change from prior threads.
Sanjay (Legal): Draft amendment AMEND-1300 posted: outlines $3k base uplift, $2k one-time sign-on, and standard <90-day clawback for sign-on portion. Sam please get signed copy.
Payroll Bot: For hire date 2026-04-20, HRIS update + signed amendment by 2026-04-13 15:00 PT required to reflect base on first run. Sign-on payout scheduling also subject to PR.
Rory (People Ops): Noting this as an atypical route (post-offer base change). I'll flag for audit trail. Once signed, I'll update the candidate record and close REQ-2026-7760.
Sam (Recruiter): Marco signed AMEND-1300 and confirmed start 2026-04-20. Attach signed doc.
Anita (Comp): Confirming final: $3k base uplift approved and $2k sign-on. Closing comp side.
Payroll Bot: Received PR#1300-UP. Scheduling base and sign-on per amendment.
Rory (People Ops): Thanks team — exception logged and candidate record updated. Welcome Marco :tada:
